##### Project general facts

The Bristol Hotel & Residences by Eagle Hills marks the remarkable reimagining of a legendary name for a new era, bringing together timeless elegance, contemporary living, and the beauty of island life in one exceptional address. This extraordinary development offers just one hundred and twenty-five residences, creating an intimate waterfront sanctuary where privacy meets the privileges of hotel living, with direct marina access, curated amenities, and attentive service blending the comfort of home with the ease of a fully serviced island retreat. From the moment of arrival, cascading water, sculpted landscapes, and thoughtful design create an atmosphere of quiet distinction, while generous spaces, elegant details, and a seamless connection to the waterfront give every residence a timeless sense of refinement.

The amenities at The Bristol Hotel & Residences are nothing short of exceptional, offering residents an unparalleled array of five-star hotel services and leisure facilities that elevate everyday life to extraordinary heights. Residents enjoy direct marina access for effortless waterfront living, beautifully landscaped pool decks with cascading water features, and elegantly appointed lounge areas perfect for relaxation and social connection. The development is complemented by a magnificent lobby with a stunning water feature, refined dining and bar venues, a state-of-the-art fitness centre, and a curated selection of retail and lifestyle experiences, all delivered with the impeccable service standards that define the legendary Bristol name.

The interiors of The Bristol Hotel & Residences are a celebration of refined elegance and understated luxury, where every detail has been meticulously crafted to create an ambiance of quiet sophistication. Each residence features generous proportions, premium finishes, and expansive glazing that frames breathtaking views of the marina and the surrounding crystalline waters, while a warm, natural palette of soft neutrals and elegant textures creates a serene and welcoming atmosphere. Thoughtful layouts maximise space and light, with seamless indoor-outdoor living that invites residents to embrace the beauty of island life from the comfort of their own private sanctuary.

##### Location description and benefits

Ramhan Island rises as a rare and extraordinary natural sanctuary just off the coast, embraced by crystalline waters and protected mangroves that create a setting of unparalleled beauty and tranquillity. Here, architecture is shaped by the landscape and life unfolds at a timeless rhythm, from serene mornings along the marina to radiant sunsets stretching across the horizon, with the city effortlessly within reach. This exceptional destination offers an elevated luxury experience where nature, design, and refined living exist in perfect harmony.

The island enjoys outstanding connectivity, with the majestic Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque and the international airport both just a short journey away, ensuring seamless access to the wider capital and beyond. Residents benefit from proximity to the Louvre, Saadiyat Island, Yas Island, and Abu Dhabi Mall, placing the emirate's most prestigious cultural, leisure, and retail destinations within effortless reach. This remarkable accessibility is complemented by the island's serene natural setting, creating a lifestyle that balances cosmopolitan convenience with profound tranquillity.

The surroundings offer a wealth of experiences that cater to every aspiration, from world-class cultural institutions and championship golf courses to pristine beaches and vibrant waterfront promenades. The emirate stands among the world's great capitals, a city where cultural depth meets bold vision and exceptional design, shaped by quality, sustainability, and precision to create enduring destinations. This distinguished address truly offers the best of both worlds, combining the serenity of a protected island sanctuary with the dynamic allure of one of the world's most refined and forward-thinking cities.
